name: NuBlox Developer Handoff Pack

product.governing_security_rule: Career != Organisation Role != Project Role != Permission

authentication_and_tenancy.tenant_authority: active NuBlox user + active organisation_members row
authentication_and_tenancy.selected_organisation_cookie: selection hint only; server revalidates membership
authentication_and_tenancy.signup_policy: fail-closed; exactly one valid invitation or organisation-bootstrap intent
authentication_and_tenancy.foreign_record_policy: tenant-owned foreign public IDs are masked where disclosure would leak tenant identity

permission_model.umbrella_policy: resolve granular key first; same-domain umbrella applies only when granular has no explicit member/role decision; explicit granular deny cannot be bypassed
permission_model.cross_domain_policy: permission umbrellas never cross domain families
permission_model.credit_control_read_policy: full finance amounts require finance.view AND (finance.credit_control.view OR finance.manage fallback); commercial/contract workflow users may receive a masked blocked/clear decision without finance amounts
permission_model.credit_control_override_policy: override is separately delegable; explicit granular deny beats finance.manage; override removes only the credit-control stop and never grants the underlying commercial/project/contract action

standard_roles.bootstrap_parity: existing-tenant forward-migration grants and future OrganisationBootstrapService grants are integration-tested for the Package 004I Owner/Admin vs Finance/Commercial split

implemented_workflow: Controlled Reminder Dispatch and Retry Evidence

authoritative_position.invoice_outstanding_formula: issued invoice gross - issued credit-note gross - active payment allocations
authoritative_position.customer_position: sum positive outstanding issued invoices per customer/currency
authoritative_position.void_policy: voided invoices contribute no receivable exposure
authoritative_position.unallocated_cash_policy: unallocated cash does not reduce customer receivable until allocated

receivables_reporting.persistence_policy: no customer-statement, statement-line, aging-balance or editable balance tables

controlled_collections.accounting_boundary: collection cases/actions/promises/disputes never become a receivable, settlement or aging ledger

collections_automation.scheduler_policy: no cron scheduler, durable worker or background automatic generation/dispatch is claimed
collections_automation.accounting_boundary: policy/reminder/delivery records never become a receivable, settlement or aging ledger

credit_control.limit_identity: one policy identity per tenant + customer + currency
credit_control.limit_revision_policy: set/revise/disable creates a new immutable revision; enabled revision requires positive limit; disabled revision stores no limit amount
credit_control.hold_policy: customer-wide stop-new-trade control; one active hold per tenant/customer; repeated placement while active is idempotent; active -> released with explicit reason/actor/time
credit_control.current_receivable_formula: sum positive issued invoice outstanding where outstanding = issued invoice gross - issued credit-note gross - active payment allocations
credit_control.limit_block_rule: projected exposure > enabled credit limit; exact equality is allowed
credit_control.hold_block_rule: active customer hold blocks named new-commitment boundaries regardless of currency/amount
credit_control.quotation_commitment: accepted non-optional quotation line gross including stored quotation-item tax amounts
credit_control.contract_commitment: sum value components on the issued contract version being executed
credit_control.override_policy: requires finance.credit_control.override or finance.manage fallback plus explicit reason; evidence is inserted in the same transaction as the business commitment
credit_control.conversion_idempotency: existing quotation_project_conversions evidence is returned before a fresh credit gate, preventing duplicate override evidence on retry
credit_control.serialization: enforcement locks the customer plus all invoice financial_documents for the same customer/currency, then re-derives issued receivable exposure so draft->issued invoice changes cannot race the commitment check
credit_control.privacy: commercial/contract actors without finance credit-control read authority receive masked decision state rather than receivable/limit amounts
credit_control.persistence_policy: no mutable used-credit, available-credit, reserved-headroom or shadow receivable balance

database_types.composition: DatabaseSchema = CoreDB & CollectionsDB; Database and DatabaseExecutor both use DatabaseSchema

validation.generated_kysely_drift: zero across core + collections outputs required
validation.status: final documentation-synchronised Package 004I head must prove the complete gate before merge

deliberate_exclusions: parent-company, guarantee or insurance limit structures
persistent editable used-credit or reserved-headroom balance
background scheduler or worker-driven collections execution

next_boundary.name: Controlled Bad Debt, Write-off and Recovery
recommended_sequence: define explicit bad-debt case/recommendation evidence separately from receivable settlement
define write-off authority stronger than ordinary collections/credit-control operations
preserve original invoice/credit/payment facts and represent write-off through additive correction evidence
define partial/full write-off and later recovery semantics before any GL integration
keep tax/legal correction policy explicit rather than inferring it from collections status
add ledger/reporting treatment only after the accounting fact model is fixed
next_boundary.governing_rule: bad-debt classification, write-off and later recovery must be explicit auditable facts; they must not delete or rewrite original receivable history
